hook: In space, your life can depend on duct tape.
title: Socks and duct tape saved Apollo 13
description: When Apollo 13 lost power, carbon dioxide began building up inside the spacecraft. Square filters had to fit a round hole. Engineers built a fix from socks, cardboard and duct tape, and all three astronauts came home alive.
comment_prompt: Duct tape or glue? Tape or glue
